from: Takes di: mi fido di te (I trust you). Non mi fido on its own = I'm not sure about it.
to: Takes di: mi fido di te (I trust you). Non mi fido on its own = I don't trust it/them, I'd rather not risk it (not simply "I'm not sure", which is non sono sicuro).
why: 'Non mi fido' means 'I don't trust it', not 'I'm not sure about it'; misleading paraphrase
